summary: Gillen is a strong defender of the U.S.-Israel alliance: she opposed an amendment to eliminate U.S. military aid to Israel, visited Israel in August 2025 and returned “doubly committed” to the relationship, and distanced herself from Mayor Mamdani’s call to arrest Netanyahu. She originally cosponsored H.R. 1007, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which applies the IHRA definition to Title VI education enforcement. Democratic Majority for Israel, a pro-Israel advocacy group, endorsed her.
